workspace.buttonGroup: Sign in to the admin site

home.heading: Admin site
home.intro: The areas your role can use. Every action and every sensitive read is written to the audit log; the server checks your role on each one, not just this menu.
home.noAreas: No area is open to you right now. Your role may have no area yet, or your staff session may be older than 12 hours: sign out and log in again to start a new one.
home.comingAreas: Appeals, Stories, Website and the other areas arrive with their own stories; the menu shows an area as soon as its page exists.

areas.roles: Who on the team holds which role and permission.
areas.audit_log: Every staff action and sensitive read, searchable and exportable.
areas.users: Find an account, see its status and sanctions, and act on it. Invite links are a tab here.
areas.metrics: The March test numbers against their targets, counted each night.
areas.on_call_rota: Who is on call for removal orders, the shifts ahead and the gaps.
areas.moderation: The report queue by tier and deadline, and each case with its decision.
areas.moderator_mail: Messages from members to the moderation team, in one shared inbox.
areas.tags: New tags writers add, waiting for approval, and tags missing a name in a language.
areas.appeals: Appeals against moderation decisions, decided by a different moderator where possible.
areas.safety_contacts: The helplines and emergency numbers shown on reporting screens, and their monthly check.
areas.classics: Add and check public-domain classics for the official account.
areas.settings: Feature flags, values and limits, the Discover mix, categories, reserved names, and markets and languages.
areas.website_cms: The home page, notice banners, help pages and questions, for each market and language.
areas.contests: Set up writing contests and open them for entries.
areas.sponsors: Sponsor campaigns, the check every creative needs before it goes live, and what we never advertise.
areas.schools: Verify teachers and set up class spaces for pilot schools.
areas.forums: Categories, forums and subforums: names, order and pins.
areas.stories: Find any story by title, username or user ID, and open it to see its details and chapters.
areas.support_tickets: Every support request from email, Contact us and the app, as a numbered ticket.
areas.data_requests: Log and answer requests to see, move, correct or delete someone’s data, each within its deadline.
areas.pictures: Pictures in All ages and 13+ stories, and pictures from under-16s, waiting for a moderator.
areas.featured: Pick Featured this week for Discover from the ranking.

pictureOpenings.heading: Uploaded pictures opened by staff
pictureOpenings.intro: The last seven days. You’re told by email too. The audit log names every picture.
pictureOpenings.none: Nobody opened an uploaded picture this week.

auditLog.heading: Audit log
auditLog.intro: Who did what, when and why, with the values before and after. Nobody can change or delete a row, not even an owner. Searching is free; exporting a file is itself logged.
auditLog.targetUserIdHint: The full user ID of the account acted on.
auditLog.exportNote: Everything the filters match, up to 10,000 rows. The export is logged.
auditLog.exported: Exported {{count}} rows. The file is in your downloads.
auditLog.noRows: Nothing matches. Widen the dates or clear a filter.
auditLog.notAllowed: Only an owner or admin can see the audit log.

failures.bad_filter: Check the user ID and the dates: a user ID has 36 characters, a date is a day.
failures.unreachable: We couldn’t reach our server. Check your connection and try again.
failures.not_allowed: Only an owner or admin can export the audit log.

invites.heading: Invite links
invites.intro: Each link lets a set number of people sign up, until it expires or you revoke it. Making and revoking links goes to the audit log. A link never records who used it.
invites.notAllowed: Only an owner or admin can make invite links.

form.label: New invite link
form.admitsOutOfRange: A link admits between 1 and 50 people.
form.noteHint: Only staff see it. A first name or a role, never an email or a full name. It goes into the audit log.
form.noteHasEmail: Don’t put an email address in the note.

made.heading: Invite link made. It expires on {{expires}}.
made.copyFailed: We couldn’t copy it. Select the link and copy it yourself.
made.notAgain: We won’t show this link again.

revoke.reasonHint: Required. It goes to the audit log.

failures.not_allowed: Only an owner or admin can make or revoke invite links.
failures.refused: That wasn’t saved. A link admits 1 to 50 people, lasts 1 to 90 days, and the note is at most 80 characters with no email address.
failures.unreachable: We couldn’t reach our server. Check your connection and try again.

users.heading: Users
users.intro: Find an account by its username, pen name, email or user ID. Opening an account shows its status, age check, sanctions and open cases. Every action and every email shown goes to the audit log.
users.searchLabel: Username, pen name, email or user ID
users.searchHint: A whole email address, a full user ID or its first 8 characters. Finding an account by its email is logged.
users.beforeSearch: Search for an account to see it here.
users.notAllowed: Only owners, admins, moderators and support can look up accounts.
users.ageNote: The age check column shows the result and date only. We never keep or show photos or documents, and staff never see the year of birth here.

account.copyFailed: Copying didn’t work. Select it by hand: {{userId}}
account.emailFailed: We couldn’t show the email. Try again.

actions.heading: Actions
actions.staffAccount: This is a staff account: it can’t be warned, suspended or banned. Remove its role in Roles first.

explain.warning: A warning is a record on the account. It doesn’t stop the person doing anything.
explain.suspension: The account becomes read-only until the suspension ends.
explain.ban: The account is closed for good: the person can’t sign in again, every session ends, and their email can’t be used to sign up again. Their profile, stories, comments and forum posts are hidden from everyone but staff and kept as evidence, never deleted. Lifting the ban brings them back.
explain.reset_pen_name: The pen name is removed and the username shows instead. The person can choose a new pen name straight away; the old one stays in the audit log.
explain.sign_out_everywhere: Every device signed in to this account is signed out. A page already open keeps working for up to an hour.
explain.approve_username: Use this when the word checks refused a harmless name by mistake. The person then saves the name themselves.
explain.correct_birthday: Use this only when the person asked for it. Pick the birthday they gave you; "Not set" removes it. The year of birth never changes.
explain.withdraw_parental_consent: Use this only when the parent or guardian asked us to. The account becomes read-only straight away and the writer is told; nothing is deleted.
explain.withdraw_spotlight_consent: Use this only when the parent or guardian asked us to. We stop suggesting the writer to other readers straight away and tell them; the account itself doesn’t change.

done.warning: Done. The warning is on the account.
done.reset_pen_name: Done. The pen name was reset.
done.approve_username: Done. The person can now save that name.
done.withdraw_parental_consent: Done. The consent is withdrawn and the account is read-only.
done.withdraw_spotlight_consent: Done. We no longer suggest this writer to other readers.

actions.dataRequests: Data export and deletion: during the invited test, people ask by email and we answer by hand. The Data requests area comes later.
actions.messageHint: Their statement of reasons: what happened and why, in plain words. If you leave it empty, they read that the moderator added no more details.

audit.more: Open the audit log for this account
audit.noMore: No more staff actions on this account.

failures.bad_filter: This account's history couldn't be read. Reload the page to try again.

messages.text: Private messages are hidden. You see a message only when it is part of a report, on that report’s case page.

metrics.heading: The March test numbers
metrics.intro: Totals counted once a night from the database. Nothing here names a person.
metrics.writersDescription: Accounts with at least one published chapter.
metrics.returnRateDescription: Reads of the next chapter in its first 7 days, as a share of reads of the chapter before it.
metrics.targetsNote: The targets are settings in the database, not fixed in the code.
metrics.notAllowed: The March numbers are for the owner and admins. Your queue numbers are on the moderation page.
metrics.unreachable: We couldn’t load the numbers. Check your connection and try again.
metrics.notCountedYet: The numbers haven’t been counted yet. The count runs early each morning.

overview.unreachable: We couldn’t load these numbers. Check your connection and try again.

overview.signUpsIntro_few: Counted from year of birth. {{count}} sign-ups so far.

analytics.heading: Cookieless analytics
analytics.off: Off for now. It switches on once Plausible or Umami is chosen and its address is set.
analytics.topEvents: The top events are read in the tool’s own dashboard. We keep no copy of them here.
analytics.catalogueBody: Every event lives in docs/analytics-events.md with an object_action name, its properties and where it fires. No event carries personal data.
analytics.catalogueCount_one: {{count}} event name in the code, and it is in the catalogue. A name that isn’t listed fails the tests.
analytics.catalogueCount_few: {{count}} event names in the code, all in the catalogue. A name that isn’t listed fails the tests.
analytics.catalogueCount_other: {{count}} event names in the code, all in the catalogue. A name that isn’t listed fails the tests.

compliance.heading: Authority orders and legal requests
compliance.intro: Each entry keeps the authority, the date, the content, the action taken and the times. Removal orders from the public report form are added on their own.
compliance.exportFailed: We couldn’t export the log. Try again.

form.label: Log a request
form.authorityHint: Who sent it, or for the launch notice, who it went to.
form.contentHint: Name an account by its username only.

complete.label: What was done about {{reference}}
complete.hint: It is saved as done now. A done entry can’t be changed later.

problems.too_long: One of the fields is too long. Keep each one under 2,000 characters.
problems.in_future: That time is in the future. Check the date and time.
problems.done_before_received: It can’t be done before it arrived. Check the times.

problems.already_done: Someone has already recorded this one. The log now shows it.

problems.not_allowed: The compliance log is for the owner and admins.

launch.noDate: Set the launch date to see when it is due.

transparency.heading: Not required for us yet
transparency.body: Micro and small companies are exempt (DSA art. 15(2)). We keep this data so we are ready when we grow.

classics.intro: Add public-domain books, stories, poems and plays. A work is published under the official classics account, with its real author as the byline, and only where it is free.
classics.empty: No classics yet. Add the first one.
classics.notAllowed: Only the admin role manages Classics.

check.heading: Where it is in the public domain
check.needsYear: Pick the author, or add their year of death, to see where the work is free.

form.author: Author
form.newAuthorName: Author’s name, as the byline shows it
form.title: Title
form.contentNoteHint: For example for violence in a 16+ work. Readers see it before they start.
form.translatorHint: If this text is a translation, give the translator and the year they died: a translation stays protected for 70 years after its translator’s death.

text.label: The text

text.file: Or open a plain text or Markdown file

card.unpublishReason: Why it comes off the site

import.heading: Import a research list
import.intro: Open one of the CSV lists from the research (content/classics). Every row becomes a draft with its author, kind, language and source filled in. Then add each work’s text, check its details and publish it where it is free.
import.summary_one: Added {{count}} draft. Already listed: {{already}}. Not imported: {{refused}}.
import.summary_few: Added {{count}} drafts. Already listed: {{already}}. Not imported: {{refused}}.
import.summary_other: Added {{count}} drafts. Already listed: {{already}}. Not imported: {{refused}}.
import.unreadable: That file couldn’t be read. Open a .csv file saved from a spreadsheet.
import.missingColumns: This list lacks the columns: {{columns}}. Use the columns of the research lists.

suggestions.heading: Newly in the public domain
suggestions.intro: Works become free on 1 January, 70 years after the year their author died. These are the listed authors, with their works and whether each is published.
suggestions.author: {{name}} (died {{year}})

typo.textHint: Correct only a typo from the source edition. Readers see the fix at once, and the earlier text stays as a version.

typo.done: Fixed. Readers now see the corrected text.

languages.heading: Languages they read
languages.hint: A language opens only when a moderator who reads it is on the rota.
languages.failed: The languages couldn't be saved. Try again.

manualChecks.heading: Manual age checks
manualChecks.intro: People whose age check didn’t work and who asked for a person to check. Answer within 5 working days. You see the year of birth here only to decide; every request shown is logged. There is never a photo or a document.
manualChecks.notAllowed: Only the owner, admins and moderators handle manual age checks.
manualChecks.none: No one is waiting for a manual age check.
manualChecks.reasonHint: The person reads this in the app. Who decided stays only in the audit log.

failures.refused: That didn’t work: the request may already be decided. Reload the page.

teacherChecks.heading: Verify teachers
teacherChecks.intro: A teacher moderates a class of mostly under-18s, so the school must vouch for them. Once approved, their profile shows a “Teacher” badge and they can own class spaces.
teacherChecks.footer: Teachers follow the same messaging rule as every adult: never with under-16s, and with 16 and 17-year-olds only if the teen turns it on. Class work happens in the class space, not in private messages.
teacherChecks.notAllowed: Only the owner, admins and moderators with the teacher checks permission verify teachers.
teacherChecks.none: No one is waiting for a teacher check.
teacherChecks.byEmail: A link sent to a school address at {{domain}} was opened
teacherChecks.byProof: A letter or staff card from the school

reasonLabel.approved: Note for the teacher (they will read it)
reasonLabel.rejected: Why not yet (they will read it)

teacherChecks.reasonHint: Write it plainly. It is kept in the audit log.

failures.refused: That didn’t work: maybe the request already has a decision. Reload the page.
failures.unreachable: We couldn’t reach the database. Try again in a moment.

teacherChecks.removeReason: Why the badge is removed (the teacher will read it)
teacherChecks.noTeachers: No one has the Teacher badge yet.

classSpaces.schoolHint: It prints on the students’ class certificates.

stories.heading: Every story
stories.intro: Find any story and open it to see its details, its chapters and its reports. Staff never edit a writer’s words. Every change needs a reason, and the writer is told what changed and why.
stories.oneOwnerPill: Each story belongs to one user ID
stories.auditPill: Every action here goes to the audit log
stories.searchHint: An earlier username finds the writer’s stories too.
stories.noneMatch: No stories match. Clear a filter or search for a user ID.
stories.listNote: Open a story to see its details and chapters. There is no bulk action: each change is made on one story, with a reason the writer sees.
stories.notAllowed: Your role doesn’t include Stories. Owners, admins, moderators and support staff can use it.
stories.loadFailed: The stories didn’t load. Check your connection and try again.

page.noSuchStory: There is no story at this address. It may have been typed wrongly.
page.deletedByWriter: The writer deleted this story. It no longer shows in the list, and staff can still open it for a case or a data request.
page.viewOnly: Your role can look at stories but not change them.
page.noChapters: This story has no chapters yet.
page.noWordsNote: Staff never see a draft’s words here. Owners, admins and moderators can open a published chapter’s words to remove an unlawful passage, but nobody on the staff can type in them.

visibilityExplain.shown: Shown as the writer published it.
visibilityExplain.restricted: It still opens from its link, in libraries and on the writer’s profile, but Discover, shelves, search and tags leave it out. The writer gets a statement of reasons.
visibilityExplain.hidden: Only the writer and staff can see it. The writer gets a statement of reasons and can appeal.

change.removedByCase: A moderation case removed this story. Only that case or an appeal can bring it back.
change.settingsIntro: Fix a setting the writer got wrong. You can’t change the title, the blurb, the content note or any words: only the writer can. A raised rating sends the writer a statement of reasons; any other change sends them a notification saying what changed and why.
change.commentsHint: Readers can comment on the chapters.
change.abuseHint: It then needs the 16+ or 18+ rating and the writer’s own content note. If there is no note, ask the writer to add one.
change.tagsHint: Separate tags with commas, at most 10. A new tag waits for staff before it shows.
change.reasonHint: The writer reads this in their notice, so write it for them. It also goes to the audit log.
change.reasonMissing: Pick a reason and say why in a few words.

reasons.story_details: A detail is wrong (category, tags, language or labels)

change.saved: Saved. The writer has been told what changed and why.

failures.not_allowed: Your role can’t change stories. Owners, admins and moderators can.
failures.no_such_story: This story or chapter no longer exists. The writer may have deleted it.
failures.reason_needed: Pick a reason and say why in a few words.
failures.nothing_changed: Nothing changed: the story already has these settings.
failures.no_cover: The story already shows the automatic cover, so there is nothing to hide.
failures.removed_by_case: A moderation case removed this. Only that case or an appeal can bring it back.
failures.not_valid: The story can’t be saved like this. A story about abuse or coercion needs the 16+ or 18+ rating and the writer’s content note, and a story can have at most 10 tags.
failures.unreachable: The change wasn’t saved. Check your connection and try again.
failures.text_changed: Those words are no longer where they were: the writer has changed the chapter since. Open it again and select them afresh.
failures.no_such_case: There is no case with that reference that you can see. Check it, or leave the field empty.
failures.cannot_restore: These words are already back, so there is nothing to restore.
failures.not_published: This chapter has never been published, so it has no words to remove.
failures.passage_too_long: Select at most 20,000 characters at once.

presentation.heading: Title and cover
presentation.intro: If the title or cover breaks the rules, hide it from readers. Readers then see “Title hidden by the moderation team” or the automatic cover until the writer changes it. You never write a new title, and the writer’s own title and picture stay as they are. Hiding sends the writer a statement of reasons; showing again sends a notification.

title.label: Title
title.hidden: Hidden: readers see “Title hidden by the moderation team” until the writer changes it.

cover.label: Cover
cover.hidden: Hidden: readers see the automatic cover until the writer picks another one.
cover.automatic: The story shows the automatic cover, so there is nothing to hide.

history.heading: Version history
history.intro: Every staff change to this story, newest first. Restore brings back what a change replaced, as a new version with its own reason, and tells the writer.
history.restoreExplain: This puts back the values from before this change. The writer is told, with your reason.
history.passageLogged: Reading these words is in the audit log.
history.passageFailed: The removed words couldn’t be shown. Your role or the case may not allow it.

passage.heading: Remove a passage from chapter {{number}}
passage.loadFailed: The chapter couldn’t be loaded. Check your connection and try again.
passage.textHint: You can’t type here: only the writer edits their words. Select the exact words to remove with the mouse, or with Shift and the arrow keys, then press “Use the selected words”.
passage.nothingSelected: Select some words in the chapter first.
passage.caseHint: For example R-000123. Staff can then find the removed words from the case.
passage.explain: Use this only for illegal content or someone’s personal data. The rest of the chapter stays as it is, the original words are kept for staff and the writer gets a statement of reasons.
passage.done: Removed. The writer has been sent a statement of reasons.

featured.heading: Featured this week
featured.intro: Every current active story, with its rank and how readers are taking to it. Pick up to five for the band at the top of Discover. Mix well-known stories with promising ones. Sorting here only changes this list: ranks are the same for everyone.
featured.notAllowed: Only admins and the owner can pick Featured this week.

viewHints.all: Every story with a chapter out in the last 60 days, top rank first.
viewHints.rising: Stories that climbed the most in the last 7 days.
viewHints.new_writers: Stories by writers whose first story came out in the last 90 days.
viewHints.promising: At least 60% of readers reach the latest chapter, with fewer reads this week than most stories.

featured.noneInView: No story fits this view right now.
featured.tableCaption: Current active stories and whether each can be featured

reasons.not_public: No, it isn’t public on the web
reasons.no_chapter: No, no chapter can be read
reasons.writer_not_active: No, the writer’s account isn’t active
reasons.writer_not_suggested: No, the writer turned off suggesting them to other people
reasons.writer_age_unknown: No, we don’t know the writer’s age

picks.heading: Picked: {{count}} of {{max}}
picks.empty: Nothing is picked, so Discover doesn’t show the band.
picks.notCurrent: A story that’s no longer current
picks.noYoungerPick: None of these stories is rated All ages or 13+, so readers aged 13 to 15 and signed-out visitors will see no band.
picks.reason: Why are you changing Featured this week?
picks.reasonHint: For the audit log. Each newly picked writer gets a notification.
picks.saved: Saved. Discover shows the new list from the next page load.

failures.not_allowed: Only admins and the owner can change Featured this week.
failures.refused: That can’t be saved. A story may no longer be allowed, or the list is too long. Check the list and try again.
failures.unreachable: We couldn’t reach the database. Try again in a moment.
